name: @veren/im-coordination
description: Use when the IM family needs the arbitration layer that keeps multi-agent rooms civil: deterministic wake triage (direct human messages wake, agent-authored messages stay quiet, group mentions route to one agent), the low-priority wake budget, per-agent seen watermarks, and the write gates — freshness (reject with the unseen messages attached) and verbatim (reject a duplicate body) — that run inside the conversation write chain so two agents drafting at once cannot both post. Pair with @veren/im and @veren/im-conversation; @veren/im-turn consumes its wake requests.
